def_en: 1) lip, language, speech, shore, bank, brink, brim, side, edge, border, binding
1c) edge, shore, bank (of cup, sea, river, etc)
kjv: band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (sea-)shore, side, speech, talk, (vain) words.
expl: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
etim: or (in dual and plural) ; probably from or through the idea of termination (compare );
